follow-up time: Not specified, but follow-up visits were conducted
exposure: pernicious placenta previa complicated with placenta accreta
outcome: complications during or after the operation
cohort: 623 patients who experienced pernicious placenta previa complicated with placenta accreta
finding: For patients with pernicious placenta previa complicated with placenta accreta who experience active bleeding after cesarean section and abdominal aortic balloon occlusion, bilateral uterine artery embolization can effectively reduce blood loss and requirement of blood transfusion during the operation, and lowers the risk of hysterectomy.
